Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Duolingo's perfect-lesson celebration - Duo and a bowing character pop in with confetti over "Perfect lesson! Take a bow!", then three stat cards (XP earned, time, 100% accuracy) stagger in below, with a CLAIM XP button at the bottom.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
White celebration screen: Duo and an orange-jacketed character mid-bow with confetti, "Perfect lesson!" headline and "Take a bow!" subline, three small stat cards (yellow XP, blue time, green accuracy), and a blue CLAIM XP button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: staggered celebration build.
- The characters spring in from below (spring ~320/18, 450ms) as confetti pieces rain from the top (~20 pieces, random drift, 1.2s, gravity).
- "Perfect lesson!" and "Take a bow!" fade up (250ms, 100ms stagger).
- Stat cards pop in one at a time left to right (scale 0.6 -> 1.1 -> 1, spring ~340/20, 120ms stagger); each card's value counts up as it lands (rolling digits, 300ms).
- The characters keep a small celebration bounce (translateY +/-4px, 900ms loop) with occasional confetti re-bursts.
- CLAIM XP fades in last (250ms).

## Calibration
- Confetti is sparse and light - a sprinkle, not a storm.
- Card stagger is left to right matching reading order.

## Reduced motion
Everything fades in place (200ms, staggered 80ms); no confetti.

## Don't miss
- The bow is literal - the character bends forward; Duo tips with them.
- The 100% accuracy card is the payoff - it lands last and greenest.
